_meta.description: Bucket each respondent into ONE bucket per distinct issuer-set mask via GROUP_SET_VALUE on the card_issuers.pulse cohort. Each row contributes to exactly one bucket keyed by its complete set membership (e.g. {VISA, MC} is one bucket; {VISA, MC, AMEX} is a different bucket). Distinct semantics from GROUP_SET_PER_ELEMENT (one row -> N buckets). The bucket count surfaces the cardinality of distinct wallet combinations across the survey.
_meta.name: group_set_value_issuers
